about: Each row is one Minecraft font the HoloCraft pack builds from a HoloCure font, so every menu and dialog speaks in HoloCure's lettering. Generates FontRow (used by the importer).

columns.mc_font: string; font id the pack writes (minecraft:default replaces all UI text)
columns.height: int; px line height in the bitmap provider
columns.fallback: bool; keep Minecraft's own glyphs behind it for characters HoloCure's font lacks
